name: vulkan
about: the GPU, as its drivers give it: drawing and computing with Vulkan (on a Mac, through MoltenVK)
license: Apache-2.0 (MoltenVK, and the headers these declarations are written from)

notes: A function is Vk.Name for C's vkName (Vk.CreateInstance), and a constant Vk.NAME for VK_NAME
(Vk.SUCCESS, Vk.STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO); a struct keeps C's whole name (VkInstanceCreateInfo).
A handle Vulkan hands out is either an address (a VkInstance, a VkDevice, a VkQueue, a VkCommandBuffer:
ptr<VkInstance_T> and so on) or a u64 (every other: a VkBuffer, a VkImage, a VkSurfaceKHR), on every system.
The library is the system's on Windows and Linux, where it comes with the graphics driver. A Mac has
none of its own: MoltenVK 1.4.2, which is Vulkan over Apple's Metal, is put beside the program.
startup: call VkStart.Quiet;    # (on a Mac, MoltenVK is told to write errors only: see start_macos.phi)
